reproduction: HSB.bind(store.evidence()) then inspect each posterior distribution

reproduction: On live Render, analyse 'Cloudflare' by name only, then GET /demo-dossiers
observed: crossing_state FOUNDER_AVAILABLE_MARKET_UNAVAILABLE, and /demo-dossiers/cloudflare-inc returns NOT_STARTED - the market snapshot was on disk and did not join
expected: The market snapshot joins the dossier
root_cause: The two sides key the same company differently: the founder files under the manifest id (cloudflare, boeing, johnson-and-johnson) and the market publishes under company_key(legal_name) (cloudflare-inc, johnson-johnson). This is the exact failure strategic_publish.publish documents as having carried zero dossiers with a full suite passing
decision_impact: Every company whose manifest id differs from its legal-name key shows no market intelligence at all, while the data exists
fix: bridge.for_company takes aliases and tries each key in declared order; each candidate is still identity-checked against the snapshot filed under THAT key, so more keys can never attribute one company's intelligence to another
